method: ticks and frame lines measured on the ink (out/FB-5/calibrate_ticks.py); no grid lines on this plot
model: x = ax[0]*u + ax[1]*v + ax[2]; y = ay[0]*u + ay[1]*v + ay[2] (affine; the lines of constant x have the mean tilt of the left and right frame lines, those of constant y the mean tilt of the bottom and top frame lines; scale and offset by least squares on the anchors of each axis)

affine_unconstrained.note: diagnostic only: its y lines lean more than either horizontal frame line

frame_line_convention: bottom/top: v = intercept + slope*u; left/right: u = intercept + slope*v
tick_convention: x ticks: u = c + tilt*v (tilt du/dv); y ticks: v = c + tilt*u (tilt dv/du); u, v: anchor on the frame centre line
